title: Evaluating 21st-Century Competencies in Postsecondary Curricula with Large Language Models: Performance Benchmarking and Reasoning-Based Prompting Strategies

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the continuous score difference between LLM-predicted competency levels and human-annotated baseline scores using regression analysis to identify systematic upward deviations (over-predicting competency coverage).

Conducting qualitative error analysis to identify instances where models systematically over-interpret or make unwarranted assumptions based on specific instructional keywords (e.g., assuming 'exams' always imply writing competencies) rather than contextual pedagogical evidence.
